Description: Unique identifier assigned to each participant (original labels Sub01-Sub84 remapped to integers 1-84).
Presentation order of the passage within the session (1-55). Passage order was randomised per participant.
Identifier of the passage that was read (1-55). Constant across participants.
Position of the word within its passage (1-based; from the DataViewer interest-area index).
Index of the sentence containing this word within the passage. Empty for the first word of each passage.
Position of the word within its sentence. Empty for the first word of each passage.
The word as displayed on screen for this interest area.
Number of characters in the word. Empty for the first word of each passage.
Part of speech of the presented stimulus.
Whether the word is a content or a function word.
Proportion of norming participants who produced this exact word form in the cloze task (0-1). Empty for the first word of each passage.
Proportion of cloze responses matching this word's part of speech (0-1). Empty for the first word of each passage.
Certainty of the cloze response distribution for this word (0-1). Empty for the first word of each passage.
Total reading time on the word in milliseconds (dwell time summed over all fixations). 0 means the word was never fixated.
Duration of the first fixation on the word in milliseconds. Empty if the word was never fixated.
Sum of fixations on the word during the first run through it, in milliseconds. Empty if the word was never fixated.
Time from first entering the word until moving past it to the right, including regressions, in milliseconds. Empty if the word was never fixated.
Number of fixations landing on the word.
Number of separate runs of fixations on the word.
Binary indicator of whether the word received any fixation (1) or none at all (0).
Binary indicator of whether the word was skipped during first-pass reading (1) or not (0). A first-pass skipped word may still be fixated later during a regression.
Binary indicator of whether a regression entered this word. Empty if the word was never fixated.
Binary indicator of whether a regression left this word. Empty if the word was never fixated.
